versions.changelog: Token验证修复：URL改为geo-api.yk-global.com/validate；新增本地缓存5分钟；自动从环境变量读取token验证

- 新增付费购买指引，增加访问链接至 [YK-Global.com](https://yk-global.com)
- 其他内容保持不变

- Initial release of Email Customer Assistant.
- Connects to any IMAP email (QQ, NetEase, Gmail, business accounts, etc.).
- AI-powered email classification: Urgent, Important, Normal, Deferred categories.
- Generates multi-language reply suggestions; replies sent only after user confirmation.
- Real-time Feishu (Lark) message push for email summaries.
- Multiple pricing tiers: Free, Standard, Pro, and Max, with varying limits and features.
- Supports OpenAI-compatible APIs and multiple languages (Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean).
- Only reads emails; no sending or deleting without user confirmation.
